verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אַתָּ֔ה אֱלֹהַי֙ אֲרֽוֹמִמְךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵֽרָח֖וֹק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן׃
verses.literal: O LORD You are my God I will exalt You I will praise Your name For You have worked wonders plans [formed] long ago in perfect faithfulness . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֤מְתָּ מֵעִיר֙ לַגָּ֔ל בְצוּרָ֖ה קִרְיָ֥ה לְמַפֵּלָ֑ה אַרְמ֤וֹן זָרִים֙ מֵעִ֔יר לְעוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִבָּנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî śam·tā mê·‘îr lag·gāl ḇə·ṣū·rāh qir·yāh lə·map·pê·lāh ’ar·mō·wn zā·rîm mê·‘îr lə·‘ō·w·lām lō yib·bā·neh
verses.literal: Indeed You have made the city a heap of rubble the fortified town a ruin The fortress of strangers [is] a city [no more] it will never . . . be rebuilt

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן עָ֑ז עַם־ יְכַבְּד֣וּךָ קִרְיַ֛ת עָרִיצִ֖ים גּוֹיִ֥ם יִירָאֽוּךָ׃
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a strong people will honor You The cities of ruthless nations will revere You

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֨יתָ מָע֥וֹז לַדָּ֛ל מָע֥וֹז לָאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּצַּר־ ל֑וֹ מַחְסֶ֤ה מִזֶּ֙רֶם֙ צֵ֣ל מֵחֹ֔רֶב כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ עָרִיצִ֖ים כְּזֶ֥רֶם קִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yî·ṯā mā·‘ō·wz lad·dāl mā·‘ō·wz lā·’eḇ·yō·wn baṣ·ṣar- lōw maḥ·seh miz·ze·rem ṣêl mê·ḥō·reḇ kî rū·aḥ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm kə·ze·rem qîr
verses.literal: For You have been a refuge for the poor a stronghold for the needy in distress a refuge from the storm a shade from the heat For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall

verses.original: כְּחֹ֣רֶב בְּצָי֔וֹן תַּכְנִ֑יעַ שְׁא֥וֹן זָרִ֖ים בְּצֵ֣ל עָ֔ב חֹ֚רֶב זְמִ֥יר עָֽרִיצִ֖ים יַעֲנֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·ḥō·reḇ bə·ṣā·yō·wn taḵ·nî·a‘ šə·’ō·wn zā·rîm bə·ṣêl ‘āḇ ḥō·reḇ zə·mîr ‘ā·rî·ṣîm ya·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: like heat in a dry land You subdue the uproar of foreigners As the shade of a cloud cools the heat so the song of the ruthless is silenced

verses.original: הַזֶּ֔ה בָּהָ֣ר יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת וְעָשָׂה֩ שְׁמָנִ֖ים מִשְׁתֵּ֥ה לְכָל־ הָֽעַמִּים֙ מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה שְׁמָרִ֑ים שְׁמָנִים֙ מְמֻ֣חָיִ֔ם מְזֻקָּקִֽים׃ שְׁמָרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh bā·hār Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·‘ā·śāh šə·mā·nîm miš·têh lə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm miš·têh šə·mā·rîm šə·mā·nîm mə·mu·ḥā·yim mə·zuq·qā·qîm šə·mā·rîm
verses.literal: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples a feast of aged wine of choice meat . . . of finely aged wine

verses.original: הַזֶּ֔ה פְּנֵֽי־ בָּהָ֣ר וּבִלַּע֙ הַלּ֖וֹט הַלּ֥וֹט׀ עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה הַנְּסוּכָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh pə·nê- bā·hār ū·ḇil·la‘ hal·lō·wṭ hal·lō·wṭ ‘al- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵāh han·nə·sū·ḵāh ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: On this . . . mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds . . . all peoples the sheet that covers . . . all nations

verses.original: בִּלַּ֤ע הַמָּ֙וֶת֙ לָנֶ֔צַח אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה וּמָחָ֨ה דִּמְעָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ פָּנִ֑ים יָסִיר֙ וְחֶרְפַּ֣ת עַמּ֗וֹ מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: bil·la‘ ham·mā·weṯ lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ū·mā·ḥāh dim·‘āh mê·‘al kāl- pā·nîm yā·sîr wə·ḥer·paṯ ‘am·mōw mê·‘al kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: He will swallow up death forever The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth For the LORD has spoken

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם וְאָמַר֙ הִנֵּ֨ה זֶ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖וֹ וְיֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·’ā·mar hin·nêh zeh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū qiw·wî·nū lōw wə·yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū zeh Yah·weh qiw·wî·nū lōw nā·ḡî·lāh wə·niś·mə·ḥāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And in that day it will be said Surely this is our God we have waited for Him and He has saved us This is the LORD for whom we have waited Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה תָנ֥וּחַ הַזֶּ֑ה בָּהָ֣ר מוֹאָב֙ וְנָ֤דוֹשׁ תַּחְתָּ֔יו מַתְבֵּ֖ן בְּמֵי כְּהִדּ֥וּשׁ מַדְמֵנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yaḏ- Yah·weh ṯā·nū·aḥ haz·zeh bā·hār mō·w·’āḇ wə·nā·ḏō·wōš taḥ·tāw maṯ·bên bə·mē kə·hid·dūš maḏ·mê·nāh
verses.literal: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw . . . is trodden into the dung pile

verses.original: וּפֵרַ֤שׂ יָדָיו֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר הַשֹּׂחֶ֖ה יְפָרֵ֥שׂ לִשְׂח֑וֹת גַּֽאֲוָת֔וֹ וְהִשְׁפִּיל֙ עִ֖ם אָרְבּ֥וֹת יָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ê·raś yā·ḏāw bə·qir·bōw ka·’ă·šer haś·śō·ḥeh yə·p̄ā·rêś liś·ḥō·wṯ ga·’ă·wā·ṯōw wə·hiš·pîl ‘im ’ā·rə·bō·wṯ yā·ḏāw
verses.literal: He will spread out his hands within it as a swimmer spreads [his arms] to swim His pride will be brought low despite the skill of his hands

verses.original: מִשְׂגַּ֣ב חוֹמֹתֶ֗יךָ וּמִבְצַ֞ר הֵשַׁ֥ח הִשְׁפִּ֛יל הִגִּ֥יעַ לָאָ֖רֶץ עַד־ עָפָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: miś·gaḇ ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·ḵā ū·miḇ·ṣar hê·šaḥ hiš·pîl hig·gî·a‘ lā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: The high-walled . . . fortress will be brought down . . . cast to the ground into the dust
